events.title: Zuckerberg Unveils Meta's First Paid AI as Free Cash Flow Falls 91%
events.title_zh: 自由现金流下降 91%之际，Zuckerberg 发布 Meta 首款付费 AI
events.summary: In Q2 2026, Meta posted $60.8 billion in revenue, up 28% year-on-year, but free cash flow collapsed 91% to $784 million as Zuckerberg committed up to $145 billion in AI capital expenditures for the year. Simultaneously, the company launched Muse Spark 1.1, its first commercial AI model, priced at roughly a quarter of what OpenAI and Anthropic charge.
events.summary_zh: 2026 年第二季度，Meta 营收达 608 亿美元，同比增长 28%；但自由现金流暴跌 91%至 7.84 亿美元。与此同时，Zuckerberg 承诺公司今年最多投入 1450 亿美元用于 AI 资本支出。公司还推出了首款商业化 AI 模型 Muse Spark 1.1，定价约为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 收费标准的四分之一。
